body:
Founder real-time (2026-09-12): re-scoped NOCK as a texture generator+manager first -- real CRUD,
SQLite persistence with the PARENA source saved alongside, and a clone affordance modeled on
CarePyre's resume clone feature (explicit difference: many independent master textures, not one
master with derived views).

Shipped: new nock_textures SQLite table + internal/nock/texture_store.go (Create/Get/GetByName/
List/Rename/Regenerate/Delete/Clone -- Clone makes a full independent row copy, not a
view-with-overrides). Full REST CRUD + clone + regenerate + generate-from-prompt HTTP endpoints.
cmd/nock texture-* CLI subcommands sharing the same real SQLite DB the IDUNA server itself uses.
A minimal Texture Library GUI tab.

Also: real Tailwind CSS v4 wired into the frontend (@tailwindcss/vite, CSS-first @theme tokens,
existing classes re-expressed as @apply compositions).

Investigated and resolved a real side question: founder asked about generating this React
frontend from PARENA source. Confirmed PARENA's TypeScript emitter has zero JSX/component
support (stdlib/editor/ui.prn is for PARENA's own native SDL2 editor, unrelated). Resolved via
AskUserQuestion to keep hand-writing TSX for now; noted as real future work, not designed.

20 new tests, all real. go build/vet/test ./... clean.

IDUNA commit 90a3abf.
